description: Plan v7 section 8.3 raw-vs-tagged clause, generated-placeholder half. Four single-axis LanguageFormTranslation placeholders (gender, cardinality, ordinality, phonetic), each keyed on a caller placeholder; two "both channels" keys that render the caller value as text AND dispatch on it in the same translation, so one observation shows both halves of the clause for a single value; and two duplicate-shape keys whose KEY TEXT contains the caller placeholder so the RETURNED_KEY failure path echoes the raw value verbatim, making the raw/tagged divergence visible in the translation string rather than only in status. en branch sets are complete for the locale (ONE/OTHER cardinal, ONE/TWO/FEW/OTHER ordinal) and every axis has at least two distinct branch texts so a tagged form must select ITS branch rather than any branch. Single loaded locale keeps attemptedLocales at [en]; tiebreakers is null because no two loaded locales share a primary language code.

GenderLine.commentary: Strict-enum axis. Only a Gender value may select a branch here.

CardinalityLine.commentary: Number-converting axis. Distinct texts for ONE and OTHER so integer 1 and decimal 1.0 are told apart.

OrdinalityLine.commentary: The other number-converting axis, reached through ordinalityForValue, which is independent code from cardinalityForValue.

PhoneticLine.commentary: The only axis that accepts a raw CharSequence at all -- and it hands that text to the PhoneticResolver as an opaque term rather than reading it as the constant it spells.

BothChannelsGender.commentary: The caller placeholder appears both as a plain slot and as the value of a generated placeholder, so one translation observes text rendering and dispatch for the same value.

BothChannelsCardinality.commentary: Numeric counterpart of BothChannelsGender: renders the number's own text next to the branch its plural classification selected.

{{who}} needs a pronoun.commentary: Key text carries the caller placeholder so that when gender dispatch fails and the key is returned, the raw value is interpolated into it verbatim.

{{bookCount}} books read.commentary: Numeric counterpart of the failure-key echo key.
